description: Finalize an upload you prepared after the PUT completed: the server sniffs the stored bytes against the declared type, bounds the size and marks the asset READY, returning the delivery url and the node to insert. Convergent — an already-READY asset returns the same; an expired PENDING upload fails (prepare again); a rejection for size, type or signature removes the asset and your repeat returns the SAME rejection (an uploader-bound server tombstone keyed by the asset id); a repeat after your own cancel fails 400 (prepare a new upload). An unknown id, or someone else’s asset, is 404. No idempotencyKey.
name: opentrain_job_instructions_asset_finalize
